justification: Both depict a winged anthropomorphic figure shown strictly in profile with an elaborate headdress and a large wing whose feathers are laid out in stacked rows of repeated elongated elements, and in both the figure's forearm is raised and extended forward — a fairly specific and conventional combination. The main differences are that B presents two interacting figures at full length in a modelled, proportionally naturalistic manner with long fringed robes and held attributes, whereas A shows a single bust-length figure in flat, heavily schematic outline with oval spots and scale-like infill, so the specific interaction and body conventions do not match.
